top_signals.title: Odd Lots: The Trilemma Hanging Over the Nvidia Crisis (Podcast)
top_signals.summary: Tian Yang, CIO and manager of the VPX fund at Variant Perception, recently published a report called “The Sovereign Impossible Trinity,” that is especially salient right now. Yang’s thesis is that the US-China rivalry is exposing three main policy trade-offs: The necessity of sovereignty (which both of the great powers insist on) means that neither state can assure they can maintain the trio of guns (or the AI ‘arms race’), butter (social spending), and sound money because of physical constraint

top_signals.title: RIP to the $1.45 Trillion FY2027 Defense Budget
top_signals.summary:
The 2026 Congressional midterms appear to have dealt a final death blow to the Trump administration’s prospective $1.45 trillion Fiscal Year 2027 Department of Defense budget request. While there remains a path forward to salvage the base budget request of $1.1 trillion, it is exceedingly difficult to envision a legislative pathway for the $350 billion reconciliation request. The reconciliation request has always faced considerable obstacles stemming from divisions within the Congressional Republican caucus, but the extent of the midterm defeat and limited legislative calendar make its prospects likely insurmountable.
